banner.title: plex
banner.tagline: Streams the NAS media library to LAN, WAN and tailnet clients, transcoding on the Intel iGPU, and shares one token with the apps around it.

explainer.title: NFS library in, transcoded streams out

steps.title: Library
steps.text: The media share from the NAS mounts read-only at /data/nas-media. Plex scans it and never writes to it.
steps.scene: a server rack beside a library of film reels

steps.title: Transcode
steps.text: The gpu.intel.com/xe resource gives the pod the iGPU, so hardware transcodes run on the Intel decoder. Transcode scratch is a 20 GiB emptyDir.
steps.scene: a chip with glowing decode lanes

steps.title: Expose
steps.text: plex.${SECRET_DOMAIN} on envoy-external serves WAN clients. A LoadBalancer address serves the LAN, and a Tailscale ingress serves the tailnet.
steps.scene: a globe linked by a secure tunnel to a glowing screen

steps.title: Fence
steps.text: Plex trusts 10/8 by design, so the CiliumNetworkPolicy default-denies pod-network ingress and admits only the named consumers. Tailscale, Wizarr and Seerr are limited to port 32400.
steps.scene: a glowing firewall grid around a server

steps.title: Token
steps.text: PushSecret plex-token writes PLEX_TOKEN into item plex. plex-exporter and the Wizarr seed read the same item.
steps.scene: a token card pushed into a vault
